selected_script.hook: Close-up of a stained, smelly wooden cutting board absorbing food juices with a frustrated home cook looking on.

script_record.pain_point: Traditional wooden and plastic cutting boards trap odors, stains, and bacteria over time.
script_record.conflict_hook: An ordinary kitchen mess where the old board looks unclean and unsafe.
script_record.product_solution: An adult family member wearing an elegant tuxedo enters unexpectedly carrying the stainless steel chopping board with a folded lip, placing it firmly on the counter.

timeline.scene: Close-up on a worn wooden cutting board showing deep knife marks and food stains.

timeline.purpose: Absurd adult family rescuer enters with product
timeline.scene: An adult son dressed in a formal tuxedo enters the kitchen carrying the silver stainless steel chopping board with a downward-folded lip, saying: 'Time for an upgrade!'
The stainless steel board is placed cleanly on the countertop, instantly replacing the messy old board.
Slicing fresh green cucumbers smoothly on the hygienic reflective metal surface.
Carving juicy grilled meat with zero staining or liquid absorption on the board.
Rinsing the smooth metallic surface effortlessly under running tap water in seconds.
A clean, modern kitchen setup showing the sleek board with text overlay: 'A simple upgrade for everyday use.'

script_record.cta: A simple upgrade for everyday use.
